name: cometal-design-system
description: Portable source repository for Cometal Design System

scripts.build: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm build:react && pnpm build:storybook && pnpm build:docs && pnpm build:provenance
scripts.build:site: pnpm validate:icons && pnpm build && node ./scripts/assemble-site.mjs && pnpm validate:provenance
scripts.dev: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm build:react && pnpm --filter @cometal/docs dev
scripts.dev:storybook: pnpm build:tokens && pnpm build:react && pnpm --filter @cometal/storybook dev
scripts.test: pnpm test:unit && pnpm test:provenance && pnpm test:storybook
scripts.validate: pnpm validate:icons && pnpm validate:sources && pnpm validate:css-variables && pnpm validate:secrets && pnpm typecheck && pnpm test && pnpm build && pnpm --filter @cometal/react validate:icons:dist
